Turner.title: Predictable motion is progressively extrapolated across temporally distinct processing stages in the human visual cortex
read_scope: Results: Characterizing location-specific neural activity, Figure 1
Methods: Participants, Stimuli, Task, EEG acquisition and pre-processing, LDA-based mapping
Turner.distinction: Original N=18; current selected calibration subset is one participant and two recordings.

specific_statement.text: 本轮特征是原先固定的早期 100–150 ms 或晚期 200–250 ms 窗口均值，减去 −200–0 ms 基线。真实输入的事件间隔中位数分别为 0.19921875 秒和 0.19970703125 秒。

window_provenance.limits: Feature-cache NPZ contains named windows only; the raw feature-extraction script and sample-index bounds were not recovered in this audit.
